Sandbox_Canastra_RequiredDecks_tooltip: How many card decks the host must carry. 0 disables the requirement.
Sandbox_Canastra_MaxDistance_tooltip: Distance in tiles to see and join a table.
Sandbox_Canastra_RequireSeat_tooltip: To create or join a match, players must sit on a chair next to a table; everyone in the match sits at the same table. When off, the maximum distance applies.
Sandbox_Canastra_SeatReturnTime: Time to return to the table (s)
Sandbox_Canastra_SeatReturnTime_tooltip: Players who stand up during a match have their turn paused; if they don't sit back down within this time, they leave the table.
Sandbox_Canastra_AllowBots_tooltip: Allows filling seats with computer-controlled players.
Sandbox_Canastra_BotDelay_tooltip: Real seconds between each bot action.
Sandbox_Canastra_BoredomPerMinute_toolti: Boredom (0-100) each player loses per in-game minute while playing.
Sandbox_Canastra_UnhappinessPerMinute_to: Unhappiness (0-100) each player loses per in-game minute while playing.
Sandbox_Canastra_StressPerMinute_tooltip: Stress (0-1) each player loses per in-game minute while playing.
Sandbox_Canastra_WinUnhappinessBonus_too: Boredom and unhappiness removed from the winners of a match.
